kjv: [so] shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed
mine: dwell in the land and cultivate faithfulness
note: shekhan-'erets ur'eh 'emunah are both imperatives: "dwell ... and tend/pursue faithfulness" (or "feed on faithfulness"); the KJV turns them into promises.

kjv: as the fat of lambs: they shall consume
mine: like the glory of the pastures; they vanish
note: kiqar karim: karim can be "lambs" or "pastures", and yeqar "precious part/glory"; either the burnt fat of sacrifices or the brief splendour of meadow flowers, both vanishing like smoke.

kjv: spreading himself like a green bay tree
mine: spreading himself like a luxuriant native tree
note: 'ezrah ra'anan is "a luxuriant native (tree)", i.e. one growing in its own soil; "green bay tree" (laurel) is a guess (LXX "cedars of Lebanon").

kjv: for the end of [that] man [is] peace
mine: for there is a future for the man of peace
note: ki-'aharit le'ish shalom: 'aharit is "posterity, future" (v.38 "the future of the wicked shall be cut off"); the KJV reads "the end of the man (is) peace".
